_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::brownian_dynamics#2, confirmed by execution with the real failure modes at both walls. The stiffness knob is not on MAT_Crosslinker: it points at a beam material through MATNUM and that beam's YOUNG is k_xl (MAT 3 in upstream beam3r_line2_backweuler_browndyn_periodic_rve_dirich_crosslinking.4C.yaml, distinct from filament MAT 1 even though both carry the same numbers). At the shipped 1.3e+09 the deck runs and passes. Too soft (1.3e+03) the linker stretches past half the periodic box and 4C aborts in beaminteraction/src/crosslinking/4C_beaminteraction_crosslinking_submodel_evaluator.cpp line 818 with 'You are trying to set the binding spot positions of this crosslinker in at least one direction' — the 'deforms like a viscous fluid' end. Too stiff (1.3e+15) the network Newton stops converging and 4C aborts with 'The nonlinear solver did not converge!' from solver_nonlin_nox/4C_solver_nonlin_nox_problem.cpp line 165 — the 'rigid, fluctuations locked out' end. Only MAT 3 moves; the filament material is asserted untouched in every arm. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the soft wall: give that arm the shipped stiffness. The binding-spot abort and its file/line vanish and EXIT_TOOSOFT becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
